description: This file defines the 'Agenda' interface, which specifies methods for managing and querying shows ('Espetaculo') and sessions ('Sessao') within a ticketing system.

classes.name: Agenda
classes.description: Java interface defining the contract for an agenda managing shows and sessions in the system.

methods.name: espetaculos
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all shows.

methods.name: cadastra
methods.description: Registers a new show in the system.

methods.name: proximasSessoes
methods.description: Fetches upcoming sessions up to a maximum number.

methods.name: sessao
methods.description: Retrieves a specific session by its ID.

methods.name: espeto
methods.description: Retrieves a specific show by its ID.
